definitions: Used to introduce a euphemism or a more polite or indirect way of saying something.
Used to soften a statement or make it less direct.
Used to invite agreement or a shared understanding when making a delicate or slightly critical observation.
examples: The decor was, shall we say, eclectic.
He has a tendency to be, shall we say, economical with the truth.
Her performance was, shall we say, memorable for all the wrong reasons.
